name: Engineering contract selection from Phase 1 drawing library

dataIsolation.guard: Resolve every drawing version from the authorized contract's tenant-local project and Phase 1 drawing index; never accept browser-supplied storage metadata.

definitionOfDone: Contract V1 and next-version editors expose a same-project Phase 1 drawing picker with preview metadata and multi-select
The server rechecks tenant, project scope, private Drive state, size and supported format before saving
Saved contract versions contain immutable file name, MIME type, size, SHA-256, source project, stage and drawing-version evidence
Original drawing files are referenced in place and never moved, copied, overwritten or deleted
Existing direct upload, carried-document, removal and frozen-version behavior remains available
Scope, privacy, provenance, snapshot, API, generated-browser-script and regression tests pass
Production commit, Render health and authenticated read-only workspace verification are recorded before marking Deployed
